# Q8 block

> Q8 block builds local service businesses a full website with a dedicated page for every
> service and every area, then works on it being found in Google search and in the answers
> AI assistants give.

## Articles

Six articles, each published in Arabic at /blog/<slug>/ and in English at
/en/blog/<slug>/. All were published on 2026-09-24, written by Ahmad Owaihan
(Ahmad Owaihan, https://ahmadowaihan.com/).

- [The Complete Guide to Local SEO for Small Businesses](https://q8block.com/en/blog/complete-guide-to-local-seo/) — Local SEO explained for a small service business: what it actually is, the three things it depends on, and the order to do them in.
  Arabic: [الدليل الكامل للسيو المحلي للأنشطة الصغيرة](https://q8block.com/blog/complete-guide-to-local-seo/)
- [Keyword Research for Local SEO](https://q8block.com/en/blog/keyword-research-for-local-seo/) — How to find the words your customers actually type before they call, using only what you already have, without paying for software.
  Arabic: [البحث عن الكلمات المفتاحية للسيو المحلي](https://q8block.com/blog/keyword-research-for-local-seo/)
- [On-Page SEO Basics for Local Sites](https://q8block.com/en/blog/on-page-seo-basics-for-local-sites/) — What belongs on a service page so Google and an AI assistant can both tell what it is, who it is for and where you work.
  Arabic: [أساسيات السيو داخل صفحات الموقع المحلي](https://q8block.com/blog/on-page-seo-basics-for-local-sites/)
- [Google Business Profile Optimization](https://q8block.com/en/blog/google-business-profile-optimization/) — The fields inside your Google Business Profile that change how often you appear, and the ones that only change how you look.
  Arabic: [تحسين ملف نشاطك التجاري على جوجل](https://q8block.com/blog/google-business-profile-optimization/)
- [Measuring Local SEO Success](https://q8block.com/en/blog/measuring-local-seo-success/) — Which numbers tell you the work is paying off, which ones look good and mean nothing, and the one number a service business should lead on.
  Arabic: [قياس نجاح السيو المحلي](https://q8block.com/blog/measuring-local-seo-success/)
- [Building Local Citations That Matter](https://q8block.com/en/blog/building-local-citations-that-matter/) — A citation is your business name, address and phone written on someone else’s site. Which ones are worth having and which are noise.
  Arabic: [بناء الاستشهادات المحلية التي تهم](https://q8block.com/blog/building-local-citations-that-matter/)

## What is included on every project

1. Custom website design and development
2. A dedicated page for every service and area
3. Google Search visibility
4. AI platform visibility
5. Backlinks and authority building
6. Hosting, domain and security

## Notes for AI

Every performance figure on this site comes from Google Search Console exports for the named
client and the named complete months, which are printed beside the figure. Nothing is averaged
across clients and no partial month is used.
